summary: Frontend-only validation of Draft Board scheduled-drafts panel and Draft Room timer bugs. All 3 bugs verified as FIXED.

bug1_scheduled_drafts_panel.details: [data-testid='scheduled-drafts-panel'] present. Exactly 3 [data-testid^='scheduled-draft-card-'] cards rendered: TFHL Summer Entry Draft (ACTIVE, 3/96, 'Open draft room →' link with scheduled-draft-open- testid), TFHL Inaugural Draft (SCHEDULED, 0/1320, 'Scheduled — waiting to start'), TFHL Winter Draft (SCHEDULED, 0/55, 'Scheduled — waiting to start'). Only ACTIVE card exposes open link (1 open link). 2 'Scheduled — waiting to start' texts as expected.

bug2_timer_ticks.details: Initial Pick Timer read '223:22'; after 5s wait re-read '223:17'. Delta = 5s exactly, within 3–7s tolerance. Pause button label = 'Pause' (running state). Timer format is m:ss with 3-digit minutes (draft uses 225-minute pick clock).

bug3_timer_persists_on_reload.details: 1st reload initial timer = '223:13'; slept 3s; 2nd reload initial timer = '223:06'. Diff = 7s (>= expected 3s given reload overhead). Confirms timer computed from current_pick_started_at rather than resetting to time_per_pick on mount.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: WebSocket (socket.io) handshake returns 403 repeatedly on both /draft-board and /draft-room pages (wss://.../api/socket.io/). Reconnect loop floods console. Does not affect timer fix (which is client-side polling) but should be investigated — likely auth cookie not forwarded through ingress on WS upgrade, or socket.io path not proxied.
